name: IU Summer Music Clinic
org: Indiana University Jacobs School of Music, Jacobs Academy
what_you_do: A week living on campus rehearsing and performing in full orchestra or concert band with Jacobs faculty, plus sectionals, a master class and an elective such as conducting or jazz improvisation.
who_can_apply: Intermediate to advanced string, wind and percussion students in grades 8 to 12. Jazz band requires an audition on the first day.
pay_detail: 2026: residential tuition $1,120 (housing and meals); commuter tuition $815 (lunch and dinner); $100 non-refundable registration fee credited to tuition. Need-based financial aid is available.
deadline_text: 2026 session June 14-20, 2026: registration and payment due May 8, 2026; financial aid application due April 13, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Online registration form plus the $100 registration fee, tuition by the payment deadline, then a Participant Agreement Form. Contact: musicsp@iu.edu.
notes: Costs and dates are from the 2026 session page. The student pays; this is not a job. The Jacobs Academy also lists other pre-college summer programs.
